europe.text: A European court upheld a billion‑euro fine against Meta, finding the company deceived users about data practices.
Russian forces launched a missile with a cluster warhead on Kyiv, aiming to cause maximum civilian casualties.
A critical PHP vulnerability dubbed “door for criminals” sparked a wave of cyberattacks across European websites.
In France, tourists expressed shock and fear as violent protests erupted near major landmarks.

africa.text: Government websites across several African nations went offline after AI tools uncovered critical security vulnerabilities, prompting emergency patches.
Nigeria's federal government announced collaboration with Uganda to halt a new Ebola outbreak, deploying joint health teams and surveillance.
In Kenya, Professor Ndetei revealed a family feud behind Dr Mutiso's murder, linking the case to his ex‑wife and children’s bail plea.

latin-america.text: Half of young people worry about AI development.
Palmeiras records its 10th penalty‑shootout win in the Libertadores, extending the Brazilian record; Flu posts one of the worst conversion rates.
Boca Juniors and Atlético Mineiro turn the Sudamericana into a special showdown for Ecuador.

middle-east.text: Netanyahu warned Iran of severe retaliation, while an Iraqi official said U.S. negotiations show no progress.
Iran’s IRGC announced that four merchant vessels were targeted in recent naval operations.
Lebanon‑Saudi flights resume with new timings; previously suspended routes now operate twice daily from Beirut to Riyadh.

asia.text: Pakistan, Qatar, Turkey and Indonesia signed the ‘Badr’ defence cooperation pact, pledging joint military exercises and technology sharing.
The UN released an assessment of El Niño’s projected damage across Africa, warning of severe droughts and food insecurity.
Tesla announced a merger with SpaceX, forming a $3.5 trillion technology conglomerate under Elon Musk’s leadership.
Iran signaled a softer diplomatic tone, offering Trump a chance to re‑engage on regional issues.

oceania.text: Westpac announced plans to cut several hundred jobs across Australia and New Zealand as part of a cost‑saving restructure.
Australia’s cricket team clinched a draw in the fifth day of the second Test against South Africa, with rain halting play.
Analysts warned that AI‑generated influencers are proliferating in the region, making it increasingly hard for consumers to verify authenticity.

north-america.text: Governments warn universities and tech firms about a critical programming-language flaw that could destabilize core Internet infrastructure.
Former Bank of Canada governor Mark Carney proposes deeper financial ties with Turkey, prompting speculation on potential objections from Trump and Canada.
Travel writer Paul Theroux traces his Canadian family origins, describing a lingering “mood of betrayal” toward the United States.
Mexican soccer club Cruz Azul beats Pachuca 2‑1, moving up to third place in the league standings.
